lesson: Baltussen et al. (2018) vol-of-vol premium and Dichev & Tang (2009) earnings stability premium, when combined as equal-weight z-score blend in KOSPI, produce SR 0.364 and negative IR (-0.302). S3 orthogonality revealed 0.83 factor correlation with existing strategies -- D41 is a second-moment derivative of D01_IdioVol, sharing the same volatility dimension rather than opening a new alpha axis. S5 VT15%+DD8/20 mutation reduced MDD from 60.5% to 27.7% but compressed CAGR to 3.87% -- the overlay cannot manufacture alpha absent in the base signal. FF5 alpha t=-0.35 confirms no independent pricing power. Key takeaway: vol-of-vol as standalone or pairwise alpha source is insufficient in Korea; may only contribute as a minor tertiary factor (<20% weight) in a broader multi-factor composite.
